question: acp-facade-cladding-install
unit: $/m2 of net cladding face area, window and door openings deducted (Auckland, GST exclusive)

band.unit: $/m2 of net cladding face area, window and door openings deducted (Auckland, GST exclusive)
band.centre: Auckland (all QV rows taken at AKL rates; WLG and CHC are the same on every row used, so the band is unaffected by centre)
band.basis: Working estimate band, not a certified price. Sum of the ten components above: 651.21/m2 low and 763.64/m2 high, giving 450 x 651.21 = ~$293,000 to 450 x 763.64 = ~$344,000 for the 450 m2 net face area (centre ~$707/m2, ~$318,000). Main cost driver (the ACP cassette system, 65% of the band) is a directly relevant QV CostBuilder row for aluminium faced composite panel cladding; the subgirt layer, flashings and the plant are likewise sourced (QV rows and a fetched NZ hire rate card); only 54-116/m2 (8-15% of the band) is priced as labelled allowance. Excluded as instructed: GST, preliminaries, margin, design, consent fees, rigid air barrier, sealing to windows, substrate repair, cavity fire barriers/fire-stopping/C-clause verification, windows/doors/louvres/soffits/balustrades/roofing, structural steel or strengthening, perimeter scaffold/edge protection/traffic management/footpath cover, and PS1/PS3/weathertightness producer statements. Two things to confirm with suppliers before this is relied on: (1) whether the QV proprietary panel rate already includes the concealed carrier and subgirts - if it does, deduct 87-100/m2; (2) the routed-and-returned cassette fabrication premium, which no QV row measures.

band.unit: $/m2 net cladding face area (Auckland, GST exclusive)
band.basis: Sum of components converted to $/m2 over 450 m2 net face: panels 520-720; subgirts 86-130; brackets allowance 40-65; flashings 70.9-97.5 (266 lm x $120-165 = $31,920-43,890); boom hire 17.8 (30 days x $267); lift delivery/pickup 0.9-2.7; minor allowances 8-15. Totals: $334,630 low to $471,600 high for the 450 m2, centre approx $403,000. Allowances (brackets, lift delivery, site measure/drawings/clean/waste) are 6.6-7.9% of the band, well under one third, so the band is established. Main cost driver (the ACP cassette system) rests on a cited QV row (unreviewed, inclusions unstated) and the flashings and plant on cited QV rows with stated adjustments.

band.unit: m2 (per m2 of net cladding face area, openings deducted)
band.basis: Sum of the eight components above, all ex-GST, Auckland. Total for the stated 450 m2 net face area: 619 x 450 = $278,550 low; 936 x 450 = $421,200 high; midpoint 778/m2 = $350,000. Component A (ACP cassette system) is the main driver at 421-650/m2 and rests on a cited QV row; B is a close QV proxy with a stated adjustment; D is a QV proxy with a stated gauge adjustment; E is a cited QV day rate with a stated hire-period derivation. Allowances (C, F, G, H) total 22.3-44.7/m2, about 4% of the band, so the band is not allowance-driven. Deducted per the scope: 15 openings at 2.0 x 1.6 m, GST, preliminaries, margin, design and consent fees, rigid air barrier, cavity fire barriers, windows, structural steel, perimeter scaffold and traffic management. QV rows are unreviewed and dated; verify the panel and carrier against a fabricator quote before adopting the band.
